JJ Smit took four wickets as Namibia set themselves a target of just 129

Ireland 129 (33.1 overs): J Neill 33 (25); JJ Smit 4-20

Namibia 131-5 (21.2 overs): L Steenkamp 46 (44); M Humphreys 2-48

Namibia won by five wickets and win series 3-2

Ireland fell to a five-wicket defeat in the fifth and final one-day international as Namibia claimed a 3-2 series win in Windhoek.

The visitors were all-out for 129 after 33.1 overs with Namibia surpassing that target in 21.2 overs.

With next year's Cricket World Cup qualifier taking place in the southern Africa nation in February, this series was ideal preparation for Gary Wilson's side.

They may not have managed to come away with a victory against the hosts, but captain Lorcan Tucker accepts his side will have "learned a lot" from their experience.

"Obviously, it was a disappointing day for us," he said.

"We came here today excited about the opportunities with the series on the line, but I don't think we quite rocked up from a skills perspective.

"We have learned a lot, but I think we've a lot to reflect on going forward."

Ireland won the toss and opted to bat, but the tone was set early when they lost Tim Tector for five in the second over.

Andrew Balbirnie was next to fall for nine and while Cade Carmichael began brightly, he became the first of Jack Brassell's three victims as Ireland's innings began to creak.

Harry Tector and Tucker offered some resistance, and while Jordan Neill's 33 off 25 balls spared some blushes, he too was removed by Brassell.

JJ Smit decimated the Ireland batting order with four wickets for just 20 runs as the hosts were set a more than achievable target.

Although Jai Moondra removed Michael van Lingen for 15 in the seventh over, his opening partner Louren Steenkamp reached 44 before being run out by Matthew Humphreys, who took two further wickets of his own.

However, a 30 by Gerhard Erasmus kept Namibia's tally on track and while the skipper was bowled by Humphries, the hosts were able to cross the line with plenty to spare.

"Top-order batting and bowling through the middle period of the innings, I think Namibia gave us a good lesson in terms of how to do those things successfully," Tucker added.

"I think we brought the required intensity, but those skills need to sharpen up a little bit.

"Credit to Namibia, they played diligent cricket and did that for longer periods of time than us - that's why they won the series today."

Gisagara: Umwana w’umwaka umwe yapfuye aguye mu kinogo bacukuramo ibumba cyari kirimo amazi, umubyeyi we yari mu mirimo yo kubagara umuceri.

Iyi mpanuka yabaye mu gitondo cyo ku wa 31 Ukwakira 2026, mu Mudugudu wa Agasharu, Akagari ka Runyinya, Umurenge wa Mukindo.

Amakuru avuga ko nyina w’uyu mwana yarimo abagara umuceri, umwana we witwa Iratsinze Alpha akaba yari hafi ye.

Igihe nyina yari ahugiye mu kazi, uyu mwana yavuye aho yari yamusize, akambakamba agera mu kinogo kirimo amazi, agwamo nyina ntiyabimenya.

Nyuma y’igihe, umubyeyi yagiye kureba aho yari yasize umwana, asanga yahavuye. Yatangiye kumushakisha, aza kumusanga mu kinogo kirimo amazi, amukuramo ariko asanga yamaze gushiramo umwuka.

Umuturage witwa Nsabimna wo muri aka gace, avuga ko urupfu rw’uyu mwana rwababaje abaturage.

Ati: “Ni inkuru ibabaje cyane ku babyeyi no ku baturage muri rusange. Umwana yari akiri muto cyane ku buryo atashoboraga kwirwanaho. Ababyeyi dukwiye kujya twitwararika ku bana bacu, tukabarinda.”

Umuyobozi w’Umurenge wa Mukindo, Obadia Tuyishime, asaba ababyeyi kurushaho kwita ku mutekano w’abana babo.

Ati: “Ababyeyi turabasaba kujya bitwararika abana babo igihe bari mu mirimo itandukanye. Ni ngombwa kureba niba aho umuntu akorera hatekanye ku buryo umwana adashobora kugera ahantu hamushyira mu kaga, nko mu binogo birimo amazi.”

Yongeraho ko ababyeyi bakwiye kugira uruhare mu gukumira impanuka zishobora kwirindwa, birinda gusiga abana bato ahantu bashobora kugirira ibyago.

MN202611_s006jct306.t:
Watch: Heidi Klum as a giant severed hand for 25th annual Halloween bash

Supermodel and TV host Heidi Klum confirmed her position as the queen of Halloween by transforming into a giant, bloodied and severed hand for her annual costume party in New York.

Klum, 53, was completely unrecognisable arriving at her event in what she described as her own chopped-off "left hand".

This year marks the 25th anniversary of Klum's party, which brings celebrities across the globe together dressed in their wild, weird and wonderful costumes.

And the revelry didn't stop there, with celebrities such as Maya Jama wowing attendees at her own Halloween party in London dressed as four-time Olympic champion Sir Mo Farah.

Klum said her costume this year needed the help of up to 20 people to complete

"It took a lot of hands putting this hand together," Klum told reporters as she posed for pictures on the red carpet. "I think about 10 or 20 hands."

Explaining the inspiration for the idea, she said: "I looked at my hand and I thought 'Hey, I think that I can fit my body inside of this somehow.'

"I always try to come up with something unusual and I don't think I've seen an actual person walking around like a hand. I thought that was something new and different."

Klum is never one to shy away from dressing up on the scariest day of the year, with previous looks including a worm, Medusa and the ogre Princess Fiona from the Shrek films.

At the party, Klum later lost the full hand costume

Other attendees at Klum's party this year included actors Neil Patrick Harris and David Burtka, who surprised attendees by dressing as the twins from the horror film The Shining.

Harris and his husband Burtka looked eerie in their matching outfits

Pop star Jade Thirlwall also attended the party in New York dressed as a stone statue of an angel, while Severance and Spider-Man actor Tramell Tillman turned up with intricate face makeup and prosthetics.

Jade transformed herself to look like she was made of stone

Tillman arrived with fake ears and tufts emerging from his forehead

Meanwhile in London, broadcaster Maya Jama hosted her annual Halloween Party dressed as Sir Mo Farah.

Jama told Elle UK magazine she wanted to dress as the "bald headed icon" to honour the Olympian, adding that she has wanted to dress up as a man for years for Halloween.

"[Sir Mo] loved the idea," she explained.

"He's actually sent me all of his real life Olympic outfits, his real, actual medals he won for the Olympics.

"His real trainers. He's even done some TikToks for me. He is fully on board."

Jama celebrated Olympic champion Sir Mo Farah

Comedian Katherine Ryan attended the event dressed as Jama, recreating one of her outfits from her recent stint on the Celebrity Traitors.

Elsewhere, singer Lily Allen dressed as every performer's worst nightmare , external - a Ticketmaster seating map covered in unsold blue concert tickets.

Ryan recreated one of Jama's most talked-about Traitors looks

MN202611_18d3h0cwdh6.t:
Dr Rok Nežič says he can't believe that he's been chosen to have an asteroid named after him

As a child growing up in Slovenia in 1999, Dr Rok Nežič couldn't have known that an asteroid that was discovered in New Mexico that year would be named after him almost three decades later.

The Orchard County may be best known for its apples, but for Nežič the real attraction was astronomy.

He first arrived at Armagh Observatory and Planetarium (AOP) in 2015 to complete his doctorate in space and climate physics, and has remained there ever since.

More than a decade on, he is one of two AOP employees to have recently been chosen to have a celestial body named after them.

Nežič, who works at the planetarium as a tours and outreach officer, said he thought it was "so cool" when he learned that asteroids can be named after people.

Speaking to BBC News NI, Nežič said he wished he "could get there some day" and, now that he has, he described it as "a dream come true".

"I'm not sure how to believe it myself,” he admitted.

He explains that an asteroid is "a smallish rock in space" compared to planets, and that his one is named (20560) Nežič. , external

"That's its official name, so the number there tells you basically the order of discovery."

It is currently "sitting safely out in the asteroid belt and just going around the Sun, just like we are", he explained.

People can visit the planetarium to learn about space

The naming process for small bodies in the solar system is governed by the International Astronomical Union , external . Asteroids can be named by their discoverers once their orbits are sufficiently known.

Nežič's asteroid is 10.9km across, while that belonging to his colleague Shane Kelly is 15.6km.

"They're both actually quite large as far as these asteroids that are named after people tend to be, because most of the really large ones were discovered first," Nežič said.

"So they were named a long time ago, and now we're finding smaller and smaller ones."

Nežič's asteroid was discovered by "one of the big missions", he said.

"This is an Earth-based mission in this case, which is looking for lots of asteroids, essentially, because the more we know about them, the more we know where they're going, the more we know which ones are not hitting us, including mine and Shane's."

The Campo del Cielo Meteorite on display at the planetarium

To be considered for an asteroid namesake, someone must nominate you, and in Nežič's case, two people put his name forward.

He doesn't know who chose him for the honour - but his PhD supervisor, and a former astronomer from the observatory nominated him.

Nežič focused on comets with polarised light for his studies and years later is "still" talking about space.

The planetarium and observatory is "punching well above our weight", he said.

"Even though we're a small institution, people who work here can just focus on the research so much that we have really top researchers in the field."

Shane Kelly has been taking readings at Armagh Observatory for 27 years

The planetarium's neighbouring observatory has monitored the weather for more than than 230 years.

Shane Kelly, who is the principal meteorological observer at Armagh Observatory, was nominated by the emeritus director.

Since 1999, his role involves opening what is known as the Stevenson screen which holds sensitive thermometers, before noting down his readings for the day into the handwritten ledger.

His hand has entered far more lines of data than any of his 17 predecessors and his asteroid is called (7050) Shanekelly.

Armagh Observatory holds weather records dating back to 1795

Kelly has been "doing this for 27 years", the institute's director said.

"He's probably observed the weather more than anyone else in the world, I suspect," Prof Michael Burton said.

"So this is in recognition of Shane's contribution to the observatory and to the measuring of the weather."

Prof Michael Burton said it's "fantastic" that the two men have been chosen

Kelly's asteroid was discovered in Chile , external in 1982.

Burton said it's "fantastic" that the two members of the team have been awarded in this way.

"There are now 29 asteroids which have some connection with the observatory and planetarium here in Armagh."

The AOP now plans on recognising their achievements with a new LED dome, which will show the asteroids and their orbits.

MN202611_ig9n1r2jil.t:
A once-obscure corner of the AI ecosystem finds itself in the spotlight – and investors don't all like what they see.

Names like CoreWeave and Nebius are familiar to the tech set in San Francisco and Silicon Valley.

These data centre companies, known as neocloud firms, run large warehouses packed with expensive computers, which they lease to major AI developers like Anthropic, OpenAI and Meta.

They're now the subject of one of Silicon Valley's most heated debates.

Many question whether neocloud firms are financially sound and what their recent stumbles tell us about the state of the AI economy.

Analysts at Gartner predict by 2030, 80% of neocloud firms will "cease independent operations", while Forrester's experts expect at least three of them to be imminently acquired "as finances get shaky".

On Thursday, Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent tried to downplay recent concerns about neocloud firms, calling them " a small component of the overall ecosystem , external " on CNBC.

Neocloud firms often finance themselves by signing long-term lease contracts with major tech customers who need quick access to computing power.

Firms can then borrow money using those contracts – plus the AI chips they purchase – as collateral, explained analyst Cory Johnson of "The Quiet Period" IPO research outfit.

He said debt is common across neocloud firms because the hardware has to be paid for up front.

Take the industry leader: CoreWeave. It's a fraction of the size of some of the Big Tech companies it serves.

But Johnson believes lenders sometimes consider the creditworthiness of CoreWeave's customers, like Microsoft or Meta, more than the company's when they lend.

"This helps explain how CoreWeave accumulated $35.1bn (£26.3bn) in debt," he said.

Some jittery investors appear to be having second thoughts.

CoreWeave stock has lost a quarter of its value over the past month, and it's not alone.

Shares in other neocloud firms like Nebius, IREN, and Applied Digital have all shed about that much if not more during the same period.

Debt investors also appear spooked, and are demanding ever-higher returns from several firms in the sector.

CoreWeave's CEO Mike Intrator has said that the market is acting "irrationally" and has expressed confidence in its business model. Some of the world's most consequential companies are queuing up for CoreWeave's infrastructure and other AI services.

Several neocloud firms have their roots in the volatile crypto mining industry, made of companies that generate cryptocurrencies, like Bitcoin.

Crypto miners use some of the same kind of physical infrastructure that is used to develop AI.

CoreWeave was founded in 2017 with a focus on mining Ethereum.

IREN, Core Scientific and Applied Digital also started in crypto mining.

Their infrastructure left them well-positioned when AI exploded in 2022 with the introduction of OpenAI's ChatGPT.

One outlier is Nebius, which was known as Yandex NV when it was part of Russia's version of Google before splitting off and changing its name in 2024.

Now, the success of these firms hinges on the fate of major AI developers and hyperscalers – even larger data centre operators which neocloud firms often count as key customers.

"There is just an enormous amount of spending getting injected into the system," said Melissa Otto, head of Visible Alpha Research at S&P Global. "It's an arms race."

But the trade-off of their model is "greater financial risk" in the face of change, said Forrester VP and principal analyst Charlie Dai.

That includes any adjustments that their Big Tech customers might make to their spending plans.

This past week, when Microsoft and Google forecast less AI spending than Wall Street analysts had projected, shares in several neocloud firms tumbled.

Much is also riding on Anthropic and OpenAI, which are both expected to start selling shares to the public in the months ahead.

If AI proves to be a bubble – and bursts – neocloud firms "are definitely going to face collateral damage," said Bradley Tusk of Tusk Ventures.

The future of the neoclouds also depend on their ability to keep borrowing, which gets more expensive as interest rates rise.

In a recent social media post, Elon Musk suggested this challenge could lead more than 200 neoclouds to "see guppy-level death and consolidation", with the smallest firms being the most vulnerable.

"Some will make it through, but not many," he added.

For now, analysts at Yorkville Ives said demand for computing power still exceeds supply, adding that neoclouds are filling an important gap that larger data centre companies cannot fill.

But to some, the neocloud sector's recent wobbles are concerning.

Microsoft recently cancelled a deal with a British neocloud outfit called Nscale amid power supply issues which could last through to 2030.

Australia's Firmus just shelved plans to start selling shares to the public.

These developments come amid a public backlash against data centres and questions about how much value AI can add to worker productivity.

"There's reason to worry," said Johnson.

MN202611_ndqahlj6yf.t:
Ese wigeze uryama iruhande rw'umukunzi wawe cyangwa uwo mubana ugona, maze bucyeye ukabyuka wumva ufite umunaniro, uhangayitse, udashobora gutekereza neza cyangwa ukabyuka wumva utibuka ibintu neza?

Kugona ni ibintu bikunze kubaho, kandi akenshi abantu babifata nk'ibibabangamira gusa, batabona ko bishobora kugira ingaruka ku buzima. Ariko inzobere mu by'ubuzima zivuga ko kuryamana n'umuntu ugona bishobora gutuma nawe ugira ibibazo biterwa no kudasinzira neza.

Dr Clare Simon, umuganga w'amenyo ufite ubumenyi bwihariye mu bijyanye n'amenyo n'ibibazo by'ibitotsi, asobanura ko kugona guterwa no kunyeganyega kw'inyama zorohereye ziri mu myanya inyuramo umwuka mu gice cyo hejuru cy'ubuhumekero, igihe umuntu asinziriye.

Umuryango wo mu Bwongereza ufasha abantu bafite ikibazo cyo kugona no guhagarara guhumeka bya hato na hato igihe basinziriye (witwa BSSAA, mu mpine y'Icyongereza), uvuga ko hafi 40% by'abantu bakuru bo mu Bwongereza bagona, kandi ko iki kibazo gikunze kugaragara cyane ku bagabo kurusha abagore.

Ubushakashatsi bwakorewe muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe z'Amerika n'umuryango Sleep Foundation bugaragaza ko 75% by'abantu bafite abo baryamana bagona, bavuga ko kugona kwabo kugira ingaruka ku bitotsi byabo.

Dore ibyo ugomba kumenya ku ngaruka kugona bishobora kugira ku muntu muryamana, n'ibyo wabikoraho.

Profeseri Ama Johal, umuganga ngishwanama w'amenyo n'urwasaya akaba n'impuguke mu bijyanye n'ibitotsi ukora mu ihuriro ry'ubuvuzi ryitwa Aerox Health ryo mu Bwongereza, avuga ko kugona kw'umuntu muryamana bishobora kukubuza gusinzira kuburyo bukabije, bikagera n'aho wumva nta kundi wabigenza uretse kujya kuryama mu kindi cyumba kugira ngo ubone ibitotsi bihagije.

Yongeraho ati: "Twebwe abantu, ntidushobora gukora neza [cyangwa kubaho mu buryo busanzwe] tudafite icyo kintu gicyenewe."

Amakuru ya BBC Gahuza ako kanya kuri WhatsApp yawe

Mu ijoro, umuntu anyura mu byiciro bitandukanye by'ibitotsi, bikagenda byisubiramo mu byiciro buri minota 90.

Ibyiciro by'ibitotsi byimbitse ni ingenzi kuko bifasha umubiri kwisubiranya no kugarura imbaraga.

Iyo ibitotsi bihora bihagarikwa, umuntu ashobora kumara igihe gito muri ibyo byiciro bifasha umubiri kuruhuka neza. Ibyo bishobora gutuma abyuka ananiwe, nubwo yaba yamaze amasaha menshi mu buriri, nkuko bivugwa n'umuryango BSSAA.

Mu gihe umuntu asinziriye, ubwonko bukora akazi ko gutunganya no kubika amakuru n'ibyo bwamenye mu gihe cy'umunsi.

Iyo ibitotsi bihagarara kenshi kubera kugona kw'umuntu muryamana, bishobora kubangamira iyo mikorere, bikagira ingaruka ku bushobozi bwo gutekereza neza, kwibuka no gukomeza kwita ku byo umuntu akora.

Kudasinzira neza bishobora no kugira ingaruka ku mikorere y'imisemburo igenga imbaraga umubiri ugira, n'ishyaka ryo gukora ibikorwa bya buri munsi.

Byongeye kandi, gusinzira na byo bigira uruhare mu kugenzura imikorere y'ubwonko ijyanye no guhangana n'ibibazo bitera umuhangayiko ndetse no kugenzura amarangamutima. Iyo ibitotsi bihungabanye, iyo mikorere ishobora kutagenda neza, bigatuma umuntu arakara vuba kandi bikamugora guhangana n'ibibazo bitera umuhangayiko.

Uko ni ko byagendekeye Meg Warren, ufite imyaka 29, uvuga ko kugona kw'uwahoze ari umukunzi we kwamubuzaga gusinzira.

Yagize ati: "Buri gihe kugona kwe kwambuzaga gusinzira nkakanguka, numvaga meze nk'umuntu uri maso cyane [uhora yiteguye ko hari ikintu gishobora kuba]."

Meg, ushinzwe ibyo gutangaza amakuru mu muryango utabara imbabare, avuga ko ijoro ryose yajyaga akangura uwo bakundanaga, akagerageza kumukorakora kugira ngo aryamire urubavu aho kuryama agaramye.

Yongeraho ko yajyaga abyuka yumva yacitse intege, atazi neza ibiri kuba, kuburyo rimwe na rimwe yumvaga ameze nk'umuntu waraye anyoye inzoga.

Kugona kwe kwagize ingaruka no ku mubano wabo. Meg avuga ko "nahoraga mubwira ko turamutse tubana, byaba byiza dufite icyumba cy'inyongera, kugira ngo ajye akiryamamo nijoro mu gihe kugona kwe kwaba gukabije".

Simon avuga ko gusinzira nabi cyangwa gukanguka kenshi bitewe no kugona kw'umuntu mubana bishobora gutuma mugira umujinya vuba, mukajya mutongana, kandi – niba hafashwe icyemezo cyo kujya murara mu byumba bitandukanye – bishobora kugabanya ubusabane bwa hafi hagati yanyu (intimacy).

Anna-Louise Dearden, umunyamakuru w'imyaka 52, na we avuga ko rimwe na rimwe aryama mu kindi cyumba bitewe no kugona kw'umukunzi we.

Kuba afite ubwo buryo bwo kurara mu kindi cyumba bimufasha kuruhuka bihagije, cyane cyane iyo kugona kwakabije.

Yagize ati: "Iyo ubyutse utasinziriye neza, urya byinshi, [kandi] ukarushaho kurakara."

Avuga ko mbere yajyaga abyuka kenshi nijoro kubera kugona kw'umukunzi we. Ariko nyuma yo gutangira gukoresha utwuma dushyirwa mu matwi kugira ngo tugabanye urusaku, byamufashije gusinzira neza nubwo haba hari urusaku rwinshi, igihe aba araranye n'umukunzi we ku buriri bumwe.

Simon na Johal bombi bavuga ko hari ingamba zishobora gufatwa kugira ngo iki kibazo gicyemuke. Ariko mbere na mbere, ni ngombwa kumenya niba uwo mubana agona gusa, cyangwa niba afite indwara izwi nka 'sleep apnoea', ituma umuntu ahagarika guhumeka akanya gato inshuro nyinshi mu gihe asinziriye.

Simon avuga ko utagomba "kugerageza kugabanya kugona kw'umuntu nijoro gusa, utabanje kureba niba nta kibazo cyihishe afite kijyanye no guhumeka neza igihe asinziriye".

Ibimenyetso bishobora kugaragaza ko umuntu afite 'sleep apnoea' birimo guhagarika guhumeka by'akanya gato inshuro nyinshi mu gihe asinziriye, kumera nk'uhezwe umwuka, guhora abyuka nijoro ndetse no kurwara umutwe mu gitondo.

Iyo umuntu agaragaje ibyo bimenyetso, ashobora gusabwa gukoresha imashini izwi nka CPAP (Continuous Positive Airway Pressure), imufasha kubona umwuka uhagije mu gihe asinziriye. Rimwe na rimwe, bitewe n'uburemere bw'indwara, hashobora no gucyenerwa ko ubagwa, nkuko Simon abisobanura.

Ku bantu bagona bisanzwe, Simon avuga ko guhindura imwe mu myitwarire bishobora gufasha. Urugero, ni ukugabanya ibiro igihe birenze urugero, kureka kunywa itabi, kugabanya inzoga mbere yo kuryama, cyangwa guhindura uko umuntu aryama, nko kuryamira urubavu aho kuryamira umugongo.

Ushobora kandi kuganiriza uwo murarana ukamugira inama yo kujya kwa muganga usanzwe, akamugira inama cyangwa akamwohereza ku nzobere ibishinzwe.

Inzobere ishobora gusuzuma niba uko kugona guterwa no kuziba kw'izuru cyangwa ibyo umubiri utaba wakiriye neza ku bintu bimwe na bimwe, hanyuma igatanga ubuvuzi bukwiye.

Hari n'igihe umuntu ashobora kugirwa inama yo gukoresha akuma kabugenewe gashyirwa mu kanwa, gafasha urwasaya rwo hasi kujya imbere ho gato, kugira ngo inzira umwuka unyuramo igume ifunguye.

Johal avuga ko hari abantu benshi bakomeza kwihanganira igihe kirekire kugona kw'abo babana, nyamara bikaba bikomeje kugira ingaruka ku mubano wabo no ku mibereho yabo.

Yagize ati: "Icy'ingenzi ni ukumenya ko ubufasha buhari, icyo umuntu asabwa ni ukubushaka."

MN202611_mixridqnz7.t:
Minisitiri w'intebe wa Ethiopia Abiy Ahmed yashyize abaminisitiri n'abandi bategetsi bo ku rwego rwo hejuru muri leta mu myitozo ya gisirikare, avuga ko ikinyabupfura cya gisirikare gishobora gufasha mu kubaka abayobozi bakomeye cyane no kwihutisha iterambere ry'icyo gihugu.

Amafoto yatangajwe ku mbuga nkoranyambaga amugaragaza ari mu kigo cy'imyitozo ya gisirikare cya Hurso, arimo gukora imyitozo ya gisirikare ari kumwe n'abaminisitiri, abaminisitiri bungirije n'abakuriye ibigo bya leta.

Ibyo bintu ntibisanzwe muri Ethiopia, aho abategetsi b'abasivile bo ku rwego rwo hejuru muri leta ari imbonekarimwe kubabona barimo gukora imyitozo ya gisirikare.

Abitabiriye iyo myitozo ya gisirikare barimo Minisitiri w'umurimo no guteza imbere ubumenyi Muferiat Kamil, Minisitiri w'imari Fitsum Assefa na Minisitiri w'ubuzima Mekdes Daba.

Ntibisobanutse igihe iyi myitozo ya gisirikare yatangiriye cyangwa igihe byitezwe ko izamara.

Mu butumwa yatangaje ku mbuga nkoranyambaga, Minisitiri w'intebe, uzwi nka Abiy, yavuze ko intego ya Ethiopia yo kugera ku burumbuke (iterambere) kuri bose isaba ko abayobozi bayo baba bameze neza ku mubiri, bakomeye mu bijyanye n'amahame mbwirizamuco ndetse bashoboye mu bwenge.

Yavuze ko ibigo bya gisirikare bitanga amasomo y'ingirakamaro y'ikinyabupfura, gukunda igihugu, gukorera hamwe, kubazwa inshingano hamwe n'ubuyobozi.

Yagize ati: "Abasirikare baba bafite aho kumasha [guhamya] mu gihe abasivile bo bagira intego. Ikiba kigamijwe kuri bombi ni intsinzi." Yongeyeho ko guhuriza hamwe ikinyabupfura cya gisirikare n'ikinyabupfura cya gisivile bizafasha mu gushyiraho igisekuru gishya gishoboye kubigeraho byombi.

Abiy yavuze ko imyitozo ya gisirikare ishobora gufasha kubaka abayobozi bifitemo kugira intego cyane, kwiyumvamo inshingano n'ubushobozi bwo gukorera hamwe hagamijwe kugera ku ntego rusange.

Iyo myitozo ibaye mu gihe Ethiopia yugarijwe n'ingorane nyinshi z'umutekano, zirimo imirwano ikomeje mu bice bimwe byo mu karere ka Tigray ko mu majyaruguru y'icyo gihugu, intambara mu karere ka Amhara n'umutekano mucye mu karere ka Oromia.

Inabaye mu gihe ubushyamirane bwiyongereye hagati ya Ethiopia n'umuturanyi wayo Eritrea, hakaba hari impungenge ko intambara ishobora kongera kwaduka hagati y'ibyo bihugu byombi.

Mbere, Abiy yashimangiye ko guhora abantu biteguye bya gisirikare ari ikintu cy'ingenzi mu ntego za leta ye.

Ahavuye isanamu, Los Angeles Times via Getty Images

Umucamanza wo ku rwego rw'igihugu muri Amerika yategetse leta y'icyo gihugu kureka gushyira ku nkeke abategetsi bashinzwe amatora ku rwego rw'uturere na za leta ivuga ko izabashyiriraho ibirego by'inshinjabyaha ku bw'uruhare rwabo mu gutunganya impapuro z'itora.

Uwo mucamanza wo muri leta ya California yategetse ko minisiteri y'ubutabera (DoJ) igomba kureka gusaba abategetsi bashinzwe amatora ku karere no ku rwego rwa za leta gushyira ku ruhande cyangwa kutabara amajwi amwe ubutegetsi bwa Trump buvuga ko ashobora kuva ku batari abenegihugu.

Icyo cyemezo gifashwe mu gihe hasigaye iminsi ibiri ngo habe amatora y'abagize inteko ishingamategeko aba hagati muri manda, azagena ishyaka rya politike rizagenzura inteko ishingamategeko y'Amerika mu myaka ibiri ya nyuma y'ubutegetsi bwa Perezida Donald Trump.

Ku wa gatandatu, Trump yanenze icyo cyemezo, arandika ati: "Kuki bakwanga gucyemura Uburiganya bwo mu Matora?"

Mu kwezi gushize muri leta ya California, inyandiko zo mu rukiko zigaragaza ko minisiteri y'ubutabera yoherereje amabaruwa umunyamabanga wa leta, ari na we mukuru w'ibikorwa by'amatora muri iyo leta, hamwe n'umwanditsi w'akarere ka Los Angeles, ibasaba gushyira ku ruhande impapuro z'itora z'abatora 20,000 biyandikishije ngo bazatore, ubutegetsi bwa Trump "bwemera" ko "bashobora" kuba atari abenegihugu.

Hashize hafi icyumweru, abategetsi bitwaje intwaro bo muri minisiteri y'umutekano mu gihugu bahaye amabaruwa abategetsi bo ku rwego rw'akarere n'abakozi bo muri California babakangisha kubashyiriraho ibirego by'inshinjabyaha nibaramuka badashyize ku ruhande izo mpapuro z'itora.

Ariko ayo matsinda yavuze ko adashobora gukurikiza ibyo yasabwe kuko agomba gukurikiza uburyo bw'amatora bugengwa n'amategeko yo ku rwego rwa leta n'ayo ku rwego rw'igihugu. Umucamanza yatesheje agaciro ubwo busabe, yandika ko ibyo "byayogoza" amatora.

Muri icyo gihe kandi, amakuru avuga ko minisiteri y'ubutabera yatangiye iperereza ryo mu rwego nshinjabyaha ku bategetsi bashinzwe amatora mu karere, itanga inzandiko z'urukiko zibahamagaza kwisobanura imbere y'inteko nkuru iburanisha yo ku rwego rw'igihugu.

Amakuru ya BBC Gahuza ako kanya kuri WhatsApp yawe

Imiryango iharanira uburenganzira bwa muntu n'amashyirahamwe aharanira inyungu z'abakozi bo mu rwego rw'amatora yatanze ikirego mu rukiko, ishinja minisiteri y'ubutabera kwivanga mu nshingano yabo yo gukoresha amatora. Umucamanza Trina Thompson yategetse ubutegetsi bw'Amerika guhagarika ibyo bikorwa byabwo.

Umucamanza Thompson yanditse ati: "Nubwo Abaregwa bavuga ko ibikorwa byabo bigamije guhagarika gutora mu buryo butemewe n'amategeko kw'abatari abenegihugu, ibikorwa byabo bishobora gutuma habaho kwivanga mu migendekere y'amatora no kwambura uburenganzira abatora bemewe n'amategeko."

Ubutegetsi bwa Trump bwanoherereje leta ya Washington ibaruwa nk'iyo ijyanye n'abavugwa ko ari abatora batari abenegihugu, busaba ko umunyamabanga wa leta waho ahagarika gutunganya izo mpapuro z'itora, nkuko bikubiye muri icyo cyemezo cya Thompson.

Ayo mayeri ari mu buryo bumaze imyaka bukoreshwa na Trump n'ubutegetsi bwe mu kurwanya ikivugwa ko ari uburiganya mu matora bemeza ko bukorwa henshi mu gihugu, nubwo ubushakashatsi bugaragaza ko ibyo bibaho gacye cyane.

Mbere yuko amatora yo hagati muri manda aba ku itariki ya 3 y'uku kwezi kw'Ugushyingo (11), Perezida Trump yashidikanyije ku mutekano w'amatora – avuga ko uburiganya "burimo kwiyongera cyane" ku batora hifashishijwe iposita no ku batora batari abenegihugu. Trump yanemereye igihembo cya miliyoni y'amadolari (ingana na miliyari 1, 4 FRW) umuntu wese uzajya umenyekanisha ahantu habaye uburiganya mu matora muri Amerika bikavamo guhamwa n'icyaha.

Ariko ubushakashatsi bunyuranye bwumvikanisha ko ibyo bibaho gacye cyane. Ishami rya BBC rigenzura ukuri kw'amakuru, ryitwa BBC Verify, ryatangaje ko ububikoshingiro bw'amakuru bw'ikigo Heritage Foundation bwasanze harabayeho abatari abenegihugu 24 bahamwe no gutora hagati y'umwaka wa 2005 n'uwa 2025.

Mu butumwa yatangaje ku wa gatandatu, Trump yanenze ibyemezo ubutegetsi bwe buherutse gufatirwa bijyanye n'ibirego by'uburiganya bushobora kubaho mu matora ndetse yasezeranyije gukomeza guharanira ko habaho "Amatora nta Makemwa".

Nyuma y'uko umukino wa shampiyona Rayon Sports yatsinzemo Marine FC 2-1 usize impaka cyane cyane ku mutoza Yves Rwasamanzi wanenze imisifurire, rutahizamu wa APR FC Djibril yibajije uko byari kugenda iyo iba ari APR FC yatsinze Marine FC gutyo. Ibi Djibril Ouattara yabigarutseho yifashishijwe urubuga rwa Instagram aho aseka cyane yibajije uko byari kugenda iyo biba ari APR FC yakinnye na Marine FC.

Ati" Tekereza, iyo iba ari APR FC yatsinze Marine FC muri ubu buryo[ Areseka cyane]."

Ibi Djibril Ouattara yabitangaje mu gihe umutoza wa Marine FC Yves Rwasamanzi avuze ko amakipe yise ko yiyita makuru ateteshwa ariko ntaho bizayageze ahi yavuze ko iyo baba bafatwa kimwe n'abandi Rayon Sports yari kuba yabonye ikarita y'umutuku.

Ibyo Djibril Ouattara yavuze ariko ku rundi asa nk'uwashatse gukomoza ku kuba abakunzi ba Rayon Sports bahora bavuga ko Marine FC idashobora gutsinda APR FC bashingiye ku kuba zose ari ikipe z'Ingabo z'Igihugu, bityo ko uyu mukeba wabo bimworohera kubona amanota dore ko iyi kipe ibarizwa mu Karere ka Rubavu itari yamutsinda muri shampiyona kuva yazamuka.

MN202611_171zo5l8607.t:
Umutoza wa Marine FC, Yves Rwasamanzi yagaragaraje kutishimira imisifurire ku mukino w'umunsi wa karindwi wa BK Pro League yatsinzwemo na Rayon Sports 2-1 kuri iki Cyumweru ndetse avuga ko byari kurutwa hagashyirwaho umutoza wa Rayon Sports akaba ariwe wisifurira. Ibi yabigarutse nyuma y'uyu mukino aganira na Magic Sports TV yerekana Shampiyona aho akiva mu kibuga mu mujinya mwinshi yavuze ko amakipe yitwa ko akomeye ateteshwa kandi ntaho bizayageza agaruka ku makosa abiri arimo inkokora Issa Djiguiba yateye Innocent ku munota wa 28 ndetse n'ikosa Junior Kameni yakoreye Bishira Latif ku munota wa 45 byose umusifuzi yatangiye amakarita y'umuhondo.

Ati "Sinabura kuvuga ikintu kimwe. Igihe cyose abantu badahinduye imyumvire imyumvire, ukabona ikipe zumva ko zikoneye mukazitetesha gutya, umukinnyi akubita inkokora undi kabiri mukamwihorera, Champions League cyangwa Confederation ntabwo bazabareka. Ibi ntabwo ari umupira tuba dukina."

Uyu mutoza kandi yavuze ko Rayon Sports yakabaye yabonye ikarita itukura kandi ko n'igitego Junior Kameni yatsinze yari yabanje gukorera ikosa umunyezamu.

Kuri iki Cyumweru, umutoza w'Amavubi Stephen Constantine yahamagaye abakinnyi 28 bagiye kwitegura imikino ibiri yo gushaka itike y'Igikombe cya Afurika 2027 izayahuza na Mali muri uku Gushyingo 2026. Ni urutonde rw'agateganyo rw'abakinnyi bagiye bagiye kwitegura umukino w'umunsi wa gatatu uzabera muri Mali tariki 13 ndetse n'umunsi wa kane uzakinirwa i Kigali tariki 17 Ugushyingo 2026, aho rwaranzwe no kudahinduka cyane ugereranyije n'abahamagawe mu mikino ibiri iheruka irimo Liberia na Cabo Verde gusa Emeran Noam akaba ari mu batagarutsemo.

Gusa hari abakinnyi biyongereyemo barimo myugariro Manzi Thierry wagarutse nyuma y'igihe yaravunitse, Ishimwe Ganijuru Elie gusa hongera kuburamo Hakim Sahabo utakibona umwanya wo gukina muri AEK Athens yo mu Bugereki, byatumye adahamagarwa ku nshuro ya kabiri gatatu yikurikiranya.

Nubwo atazakina umukino ubanza kubera amakarita y'umuhondo ariko Mugisha Bonheur ukinira Al Hazem yo muri Saudi Arqbia nawe ari kuri uru rutonde kuko yemerewe gukina umukino uzabera kuri Stade Amahoro.

Kugeza ubu Amavubi ayoboye itsinda rya 11,aho afite amanota atandatu yakuye mu mikino ibiri yose yatsinze, amanota ariko inganya na Mali.

Mu mpera z'iki cyumweru hakinwe imikino y'umunsi wa karindwi wa BK Pro League aho APR FC na Rayon Sports zatsindiye Etincelles FC na Marine FC i Rubavu. Ni imikino yatangiye gukinwa ku wa Gatanu w'iki cyumweru aho ikipe ya Kiyovu Sports yatsinze Kigali FC ibitego 2-0 byatsinzwe na Mugisha Didier ku munota wa 36 ndetse na Hamiss Hakim ku munota wa 68. Uyu munsi wa karindwi wari ufite umwihariko w'uko amakipe ya Rayon Sports na APR FC yari mu karere ka Rubavu aho yari yasuye Marine FC na Etincelles FC.

Ku wa Gatandatu, ikipe ya Etincelles FC yakiriye APR FC kuri Stade Umuganda mu mukino watangiye Saa Cyenda z'igicamunsi. Iminota 45 y'uyu munsi yarangiye amakipe akinganya 0-0 hongerwaho indi ine ariyo APR FC yafunguyemo amazamu ku gitego cyatsinzwe na William Togui Mel igice cya mbere kirangira ari 1-0.

Rayon Sports imbere y'iyi stade yari yuzuye abafana benshi niyo yatangiye ifungura amazamu ku munota wa 14 ku gitego cyatsinzwe na Junior Kameni wateye icyugazi umunyezamu akarekura umupira yari yafashe n'amaboko agiye kuwutera.

Amakosa ku banyezamu yakomeje kuba menshi, maze ku munota wa 71 w'umukino umunyezamu wa Marine FC Nshimyumuremyi Vincent ashaka gutera umupira n'ikirenge awihera rutahizamu Junior Kameni wari imbere y'izamu rya Marine FC ahita acenga Bishira Latif umupira awutera mu izamu atsinda igitego cya kabiri.

Iminota 90 yarangiye Rayon Sports ikiyoboye umukino hongerwaho indi minota ine nayo yarangiye iyi kipe yegukanye intsinzi, itsinze ibitego 2-1, ibonye intsinzi ya kabiri mu mikino ine imaze gukina muri shampiyona aho ifite amanota arindwi kuri 12.

Impuzamashyirahamwe y’Umupira w’Amaguru muri Afurika (CAF) yatangaje ko Samson Adamu yagizwe Umunyamabanga Mukuru wayo, nyuma y'amezi asaga arindwi yari amaze akora izi nshingano by’agateganyo. Adamu yemejwe n’Inama Nyobozi ya CAF (EXCO) muri iki cyumweru, nyuma yo guhabwa izi nshingano by’agateganyo muri Werurwe 2026.

Perezida wa CAF, Dr. Patrice Motsepe, yavuze ko ishyirwaho rye ryakurikiye igikorwa cyo gushaka uguomba kujya muri uyu mwanya bitari agateganyo, aho byatangajwe ku mugaragaro kandi hakorwa n'ibizamini by'akazi kuri uwo mwanya ku bakandida batandukanye.

Samson Adamu afite ubunararibonye mu miyoborere y’umupira w’amaguru muri Afurika. Yinjiye muri CAF mu 2018, agirwa Umuyobozi ushinzwe amarushanwa (Director of Competitions), nyuma aza no kuyobora ibikorwa bijyanye n’amarushanwa n’ibindi bikorwa bya CAF (Director of Tournaments and Events).

Mu gihe amaze muri CAF, yagize uruhare rukomeye mu gutegura no gushyira mu bikorwa amarushanwa akomeye yo ku mugabane wa Afurika, arimo Igikombe cya Afurika cy’ibihugu, kizwi nka AFCON, ari na yo marushanwa akomeye kurusha ayandi ategurwa n’iyi mpuzamashyirahamwe.

Adamu kandi yarangije amasomo ya FIFA Master ajyanye n’imiyoborere mpuzamahanga, amategeko n’ubumenyi bifitanye isano na Siporo.

Mu nshingano nshya, azaba ashinzwe gucunga ibikorwa bya buri munsi bya CAF no gufasha gushyira mu bikorwa gahunda n’ingamba z’iyi mpuzamashyirahamwe zigamije guteza imbere umupira w’amaguru muri Afurika.

Ishyirwaho rye rije mu gihe CAF ikomeje ibikorwa byo guteza imbere amarushanwa yayo no kongera ubushobozi bw’imiyoborere y’umupira w’amaguru ku mugabane wa Afurika.
